desc: Parse input: read N, M, X and build two adjacency lists: out[v] (original direction) and inn[v] (reverse direction).
Implement Dijkstra over states encoded as (v, p) with dist arrays dist0[v], dist1[v] initialized to infinity; set dist0[1] = 0 and push (0, 1, 0) into the heap.
On popping (d, v, p), skip if stale; relax neighbors: if p == 0 use out[v], else use inn[v], each with cost d+1; also relax the flip (v, 1-p) with cost d+X.
After Dijkstra completes, compute answer as min(dist0[N], dist1[N]) and print it.
Verify correctness against the provided samples mentally (e.g., sample 2 gives 3 via one flip) and check edge cases like X larger than path cost and large answers (sample 3).
